title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: priority content for the Risky AI usage template
summary: Hold: both policy configuration routes omit the required policy-category choice before selecting the template. The licensing discussion also says it is unclear whether per-user licensing applies, although Microsoft's service description includes Insider Risk Management in named subscriptions. The roadmap details and most of the documented behaviour are supported.

claims.claim: The priority-content route goes directly from Policy template to Risky AI usage without selecting a policy category.
claims.quote: On the Policy template page, choose a policy category and then select the template for the new policy.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].ui.path with 'Insider Risk Management > Policies > Create policy > Policy template > policy category > Risky AI usage > Content to prioritize > I want to prioritize content'. Here 'policy category' is a placeholder for the category the administrator chooses, not an invented category label. Keep the existing note that Learn does not name this template's category. The configure page documents the workflow; the cited policies page documents Risky AI usage priority-content support.

claims.claim: The priority-only-scoring route goes directly from Policy template to Risky AI usage without selecting a policy category.
claims.quote: On the Policy template page, choose a policy category and then select the template for the new policy.
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].ui.path with 'Insider Risk Management > Policies > Create policy > Policy template > policy category > Risky AI usage > Content to prioritize > I want to prioritize content > Scoring > Get alerts only for activity that includes priority content'. Use 'policy category' as a chosen-category placeholder, not as a literal label. The configure page documents the workflow and scoring choice, while the cited policies page establishes applicability to Risky AI usage.
